Step 2.1 says the 8×8 true-to-zero cross block is a direct sum of four 4×4 blocks, which is dimensionally impossible. Identify the four 4×4 blocks in the full 16×16 masked symmetric matrix, then justify the resulting norm ||B||.

The theorem permits constant g even when g’s constant output string is outside D_f; then D_h is empty and h is not a Boolean query problem under the local nonempty-domain definition. Require D_h≠∅ or otherwise restrict the statement to valid nonempty block domains.
